tree.heading: Submission of plan
tree.text: The chief executive officer of a State, in order to be eligible for grants from an allotment under section 12337, 12338, or 12339 1 of this title for any fiscal year, shall prepare and submit to the Commissioner a State plan for a 3-year period.

tree.heading: Revisions of plan
tree.text: Each chief executive officer of a State may make annual revisions of the State plan referred to in subsection (a).

tree.heading: Content of plan
tree.text: The chief executive officer of a State shall include within the State plan of that State assurances as required under sections 2 12337, 12338, or 12339 1 of this title, and a description of the proposed multi-year plans of the State for program development and implementation.

tree.heading: Type of application
tree.text: A State may apply for funds under one or more of the following categories: In the case of each category, the State application and plan shall comply only with the requirements of the appropriate section.

children.text: sections 12337 and 12338 of this title jointly; or

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Commissioner shall approve any State plan under sections 12337 and 12338 of this title that the Commissioner determines meets the requirements of such sections.

children.heading: Notice and opportunity to correct deficiencies
children.text: The Commissioner shall not make a final determination disapproving any State plan, modifying such plan, or declaring a State to be ineligible to receive funds under sections 12337 and 12338 of this title without previously affording such State reasonable notice and opportunity to correct deficiencies in its application.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 12339 of this title, referred to in subsecs. (a), (c), and (d)(3), was repealed by Pub. L. 103–252, title IV, § 401(b)(1), May 18, 1994, 108 Stat. 672.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Oct. 1, 1990, see section 1001(a) of Pub. L. 101–501, set out as an Effective Date of 1990 Amendment note under section 8621 of this title.
